text.hi: किताब: पाँच देशभक्त नेताओं की तस्वीरें चिपकाओ और हर एक पर पाँच वाक्य लिखो। फिर कक्षा का खेल: तीन बातें बताओ, दूसरी टीम पहचाने। उदाहरण: This is the girl who wears glasses, is very punctual and sings very well.
text.hinglish: Kitaab: paanch deshbhakt netaaon ki tasveerein chipkaao aur har ek par paanch vaakya likho. Phir kaksha ka khel: teen baatein batao, doosri team pehchaane. Udaaharan: This is the girl who wears glasses, is very punctual and sings very well.
text.en: The book: paste pictures of five patriotic leaders and write five sentences on each. Then the class game: say three things, the other team guesses. Example: This is the girl who wears glasses, is very punctual and sings very well.

steps.question: This is the man who was born in Bhabra, was Bhagat Singh's mentor and was never caught alive.
This is the man who led the Salt March, believed in non-violence and is called the Father of the Nation.
This is the leader who formed the Azad Hind Fauj and said ‘Give me blood, and I will give you freedom’.
Azad's favourite couplet ends with ...
options: ‘Azad hee rahe hain, Azad hee rahenge.’
steps.answer: ‘Azad hee rahe hain, Azad hee rahenge.’
